title: Micah Bible Quiz - Chapter 5
description: Ten questions on Micah 5: the ruler from Bethlehem Ephrathah, the remnant of Jacob, and what Yahweh will cut off.

questions.text: Which town, small among the clans of Judah, will produce a ruler in Israel?
questions.explanation: Micah 5:2 says that out of Bethlehem Ephrathah, small among the clans of Judah, one will come who is to be ruler in Israel.

questions.text: What does the text say about the goings out of the one who will come?
questions.explanation: Micah 5:2 says his goings out are from of old, from ancient times.

answers.text: They are hidden from the eyes of men
They begin in the land of Assyria
They are written in the book of kings
They are from of old, from ancient times

questions.text: In whose strength will he stand and shepherd?
questions.explanation: Micah 5:4 says he shall stand and shepherd in the strength of Yahweh, in the majesty of the name of Yahweh his God.

answers.text: In the strength of his own arm
In the strength of the nations

questions.text: How many shepherds will be raised up when Assyria invades the land?
questions.explanation: Micah 5:5 says that then they will raise against him seven shepherds, and eight leaders of men.

questions.text: Besides the land of Assyria, which land will they rule?
questions.explanation: Micah 5:6 says they will rule the land of Assyria with the sword, and the land of Nimrod in its gates.

questions.text: What is the remnant of Jacob among many peoples compared to in verse 7?
questions.explanation: Micah 5:7 says the remnant of Jacob will be like dew from Yahweh, like showers on the grass.

questions.text: Which animal is the remnant of Jacob among the nations compared to in verse 8?
questions.explanation: Micah 5:8 compares the remnant of Jacob to a lion among the animals of the forest, a young lion among the flocks.

questions.text: What does Yahweh say he will cut off and destroy in that day?
questions.explanation: In Micah 5:10 Yahweh says he will cut off their horses from among them and destroy their chariots.

answers.text: Their vines and their fig trees

questions.text: What does Yahweh say he will destroy from their hand?
questions.explanation: In Micah 5:12 Yahweh says he will destroy witchcraft from their hand.

questions.text: On whom will Yahweh execute vengeance in anger and wrath?
questions.explanation: Micah 5:15 says Yahweh will execute vengeance in anger and wrath on the nations that didn't listen.

answers.text: On the kings of Judah alone
On the priests of the high places
On the shepherds of the flock
On the nations that didn't listen
